options_hindi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है
A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.question_english: Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): A Principal can sanction Earned Leave to a teacher for a period up to 120 days at a time. Reason (R): Under the delegation of financial and administrative powers, the Head of School has absolute authority over all types of long leave for Group B and C staff without routing it to higher administrative authority.

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: A Principal, acting as Head of Office, has delegated powers to sanction Earned Leave up to 120 days for Group B and C school staff. However, the Principal does not possess absolute administrative power over all long leaves, as certain long leaves or extensions require higher sanctioning departmental authorities

questions.question_english: Under FR 22(I)(a)(2), if a government servant is appointed to a higher post which does not involve duties and responsibilities of greater importance, how is their pay fixed?

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A): उपयोग न की गई कार्यग्रहण अवधि को सरकारी कर्मचारी के अर्जित अवकाश खाते में जमा किया जा सकता है।
कारण (R): इससे कर्मचारियों को अधिकतम अनुमेय कार्यग्रहण अवधि पूरी समाप्त किए बिना शीघ्र नए पद पर कार्यभार ग्रहण करने का प्रोत्साहन मिलता है।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है
A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.question_english: Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Unutilized joining time can be credited to the Earned Leave account of the government servant. Reason (R): This acts as an incentive for employees to assume charge of their new assignment promptly without exhausting the maximum admissible joining time.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Under Central Civil Services Joining Time Rules, unutilized joining time can be credited to the Earned Leave account of a government servant, subject to the maximum accumulation limit. This provision serves as an administrative incentive for employees to assume charge of their new official assignment promptly without exhausting maximum transit days
questions.explanation_hindi: joining time का पूरा उपयोग न होने पर नियमों के अनुसार शेष अवधि अर्जित अवकाश में जमा की जा सकती है। यह समय स्वतः व्यर्थ नहीं होता, लेकिन जमा की मात्रा संबंधित नियमों और वास्तविक स्थिति के अधीन रहती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)
Correct option: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
